## Definition
The fractal scaling structure of multipartite entanglement entropy observed in monitored quantum circuits under projective measurements. Provides a theoretical framework for understanding how entanglement structures evolve in neuromorphic quantum systems, potentially informing the design of in-network entanglement-based computation.
